description:
Title: Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks

When building a custom machine out of Lego bricks, you first need to develop the basic design.
After that, you order certain Lego brick sets.
You give the lego sets to a group of children which should sort the parts for you (into a number of containers).
Your machine is built out of a number of subcomponents.
You build them individually, using parts from the sorted containers.
If there are no more parts in a container, you reorder individual parts.
After building each subcomponent, you have to test them individually and (if each test is successful) assemble them.
If subcomponents are not tested successfully, you have to redesign and rebuild them.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lego-machine">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BuildCustomMachine" name="Building a custom machine out of Lego bricks" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Main">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Builder" name="Builder">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Building</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DevelopDesign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderSets</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GiveSetsToChildren</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_BuildAndTestEachSubcomponent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssembleSubcomponents</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_MachineAssembled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Children" name="Children">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SortParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Building" name="Start building the machine"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DevelopDesign" name="Develop the basic design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSets" name="Order Lego brick sets"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveSetsToChildren" name="Give Lego brick sets to the children"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_SortParts" name="Sort parts into containers"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_BuildAndTestEachSubcomponent" name="Build and test each subcomponent">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Subcomponent" name="Start a subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckParts" name="Parts remain in a container?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderParts" name="Reorder individual parts"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildMerge" name="Continue building"/>
      <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_BuildSubcomponent" name="Build subcomponent using parts from the sorted containers"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSubcomponent" name="Test subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Subcomponent test successful?"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" name="Redesign subcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SubcomponentSuccessful" name="Subcomponent test successful"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sub_Start_CheckParts" sourceRef="StartEvent_Subcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_CheckParts"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckParts_Remain" name="Parts remain" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckParts" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">partsRemain</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckParts_Empty" name="No parts remain" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckParts" targetRef="Task_ReorderParts"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_BuildMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderParts" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildMerge_Build" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildMerge" targetRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Test" sourceRef="Task_BuildSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_TestSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Result" sourceRef="Task_TestSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Result_Success" name="Test successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="EndEvent_SubcomponentSuccessful">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">testSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Result_Unsuccessful" name="Test unsuccessful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Redesign_CheckParts" sourceRef="Task_RedesignSubcomponent" targetRef="Gateway_CheckParts"/>

      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="true">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">numberOfSubcomponents</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_AssembleSubcomponents" name="Assemble the subcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MachineAssembled" name="Custom machine assembled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Design" sourceRef="StartEvent_Building" targetRef="Task_DevelopDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Design_Order" sourceRef="Task_DevelopDesign" targetRef="Task_OrderSets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_Give" sourceRef="Task_OrderSets" targetRef="Task_GiveSetsToChildren"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Give_Sort" sourceRef="Task_GiveSetsToChildren" targetRef="Task_SortParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sort_Subcomponents" sourceRef="Task_SortParts" targetRef="SubProcess_BuildAndTestEachSubcomponent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Subcomponents_Assemble" sourceRef="SubProcess_BuildAndTestEachSubcomponent" targetRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponents"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assemble_End" sourceRef="Task_AssembleSubcomponents" targetRef="EndEvent_MachineAssembled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
